'''Daan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] naval [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] who served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Daan was part of the crew of the ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]''. During the infiltration of the [[Starcrusher (decoy)|mock-''Starcrusher'']], Daan was left behind by her crew on board the trap and made to cooperate with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in order to survive.

She helped the knights locate space suits and determine the coordinates to the reactor core on the real battleship. While the rest of the crew were killed when the ''Starcrusher'' plunged into a star, Daan survived alongside the Jedi.

==Appearances==
